title: Forward susi peers, susi commits and the cluster MCP tools to Susi Commercial Apps
goal: Vision: V-10. Mandate 84 (non-pillar features move too; multi-node governance is Fleet Command, Guardrail 2). Commercial serves susi-commercial peers and susi-commercial commits (3e4744e3, 18/18 side-by-side parity) and answers fleet.cluster.v1 on the plug host (T-CORESIZEFIX-8). Core's susi peers and susi commits forward their flags to susi-commercial (naming it when it is not installed); GMCP's peers_* and commits_* MCP tools keep their names, schemas, argument checks and error classes and request fleet.cluster.v1 over the plane bus; core deletes susi-core peer_roster.rs, peer_admin.rs, peer_probe.rs and commit_log_report.rs and the two CLI bodies (about 3,400 counted lines) with their tests, which commercial carries.

reuse.searched: commercial susi-fleet-command::cluster (the moved modules and CLIs) and its fleet.cluster.v1 plug; core's susi top forward (src/cli/top_cli.rs, vault_exec::run_commercial) and the operator_snapshot bus facade as the patterns; nothing new is built in core.

limitations: Windows x86_64 first, then the Linux run in WSL before the deletion lands. A live pass (private daemon on a port offset plus the commercial plug host) checks the MCP tools side by side with the old build. The clap definitions stay in core for help and flag parsing.
